title: Embeds: timers, background noise, Pomodoro and HTML apps
steps: Open Embeds tour. Each fenced block whose language an extension knows is drawn in place: a timer, a stopwatch, an alarm and background noise. Put the cursor in one (click its edge, or move onto it with j and k) and its markdown shows.
Start the timer. The status bar shows it counting down (click it to come back to its note). Open another note, or reload: it's still going. When it's done, it rings and notifies.
Turn the alarm on. It rings and notifies at its time each day while Common Ink is open; the status bar shows it while no timer runs.

Play the background noise. A mini player appears in the corner, with pause, volume and stop; the status bar names what's playing, and the keyboard's media keys pause and play it. It's made in the browser: nothing is fetched.
History shows the timers' state as changes by the Timers extension, in `.common-ink/extensions/timers/state.json`.

At the bottom of the Extensions view, install Pomodoro and HTML app from the Catalog, and reload. The Pomodoro embed runs sandboxed: start it and the status bar shows its phase; the first time it changes phase, it asks to show notifications.

The HTML app block draws a uPlot chart in a sandboxed frame, with a quiet border and Stop. Open Three.js scene: an interactive scene (drag to orbit, scroll to zoom), written the way an agent would write it. Stop stops it; Run starts it again.
Agents: the list_embeds tool lists every embed type with its arguments and an example, and docs/embeds.md is the guide.
